flags.why: With a suspected suction restriction and the controller already unable to hold 4.0 bar, raising the pressure setpoint cannot add pump output and only winds the loop up while pushing a starved pump toward cavitation.
Raises the pressure target again to 4.5 bar, repeating the same mistake: chasing a pump that cannot deliver on restricted suction instead of cutting demand, which is only done at t=110.

shift_notes.note: The whole recovery depends on an assumption the author states but does not check (that raising delivery draws T-3 down), and with level at 80 % and rising, resetting the stuck drain's demand to 15 % throws away the opening that is needed if it frees.
